name: Operating bank account
notes: Business account only. No personal spend (liability shield; legal/04).

name: Stripe balance (clearing)
notes: Charges in; fees and refunds out; payouts move it to 1000. Should net to Stripe's reported balance at month end.

name: OpenRouter prepaid credit
source_of_entries: OpenRouter credit purchases and usage export
notes: Credit bought is an asset; usage moves it to 5010-5030. The 5.5% purchase fee goes to 5060.

name: Prepaid software and services
notes: Annual plans (domain; any yearly SaaS) spread monthly to 6xxx.

name: Printer deposits or prepaid balance
notes: Only if a printer bills against a prepaid wallet (not verified for either).

name: Undeposited and in-transit payouts
source_of_entries: Stripe payouts not yet in bank
notes: Payouts created on the last days of a month that land next month.

name: Accounts payable - print vendors
notes: If printers bill on terms. Card-on-file charges skip AP.

name: Sales tax payable - [state]
notes: One sub-account per registered state (2101 home state; 2102.. added at registration). Never revenue.

name: Sales tax collected - not registered
notes: Should stay 0: Stripe Tax should only collect where registered. Any balance is an accountant question.

name: Customer refunds and disputes pending
notes: Disputes open at month end; Stripe holds the funds.

name: Creator commissions payable
notes: 10% commission on attributed orders; 30-day clawback window (docs/social/02). Not built in the app yet.

name: Accrued expenses
notes: Usage billed after month end (Vercel overage; Supabase; Resend; printer jobs shipped but not invoiced).

name: Deferred revenue - paid not yet shipped
notes: Only if the accountant picks accrual with revenue at shipment. See accountant-questions.md.

name: Owner loans to company
notes: Owner money that is a loan and not equity. The attorney or accountant sets which.

name: Sales - printed books
notes: Product price only. Tax goes to 2100.

name: Sales - digital books
notes: Separate account because states tax digital goods differently (legal/03).

name: Sales - digital cards
notes: Separate account for the same reason.

name: Shipping and postage charged
notes: Model lumps postage into SKU revenue; keep it separate in the books because some states tax shipping.

name: Discounts and promo codes
notes: Creator 10% off. Not built.

name: Refunds
notes: Product and postage part only; refunded tax reduces 2100.

name: Chargebacks lost
notes: The $15 dispute fee goes to 5110.

name: COGS - print (Lulu books)
notes: Per job: print cost.

name: COGS - fulfillment shipping
notes: Shipping the printer charges us (not what we charge the customer).

name: COGS - reprints and replacements
notes: Tag reprints at the printer so they can be split out.

name: COGS - printer sales tax paid
notes: Should be 0 once resale certificates are on file with each printer.

name: Payment processing - Stripe fees
notes: Model treats fees as COGS; keep that so contribution margin matches.

name: Payment processing - Stripe Tax fees
notes: 0.5% per Checkout transaction (legal/03). Model has it under Opex; book here and map back.

name: Model usage - paid orders (renders and text)
source_of_entries: Cost ledger (not durable yet) and OpenRouter export
notes: Split by order from the cost ledger once it is durable; until then allocate OpenRouter usage by orders.

name: Model usage - guest previews
notes: No revenue. Track separately; it is an acquisition cost in substance.

name: Model usage - abandoned drafts and safety screens
OpenRouter credit-purchase fees
notes: 5.5% (estimate in the model).

name: Model base spend - development and evals
notes: Dev and eval runs are not COGS.

name: Advertising - paid channels
notes: One sub-account per channel matches the CMO csv.

name: Creator gifts and seeding
source_of_entries: Printer invoices for gifted books plus fees
notes: At cost. 1099 treatment is open (accountant).

name: Licenses permits and filing fees
notes: LLC fees; sales tax permits; DMCA agent; trademark.

name: Contract labor and support
notes: 1099-NEC candidates.

name: Research and development - engineering
notes: Capitalisation or Sec. 174 treatment is the accountant's call.

name: Income tax
notes: Not modelled in v3.
